meta.description: Bamboo trim sheet (1.5 m): three culm-skin bands (nodes 0.3-0.4 m), coir lashing coils, 2/2 twill split-lath weave (0.825 m band).
Banner pole + crossbar + finial + tassels and the six BannerShape cloths (variants), cloth weights in COLOR_0.r.

meta.clothWeight: COLOR_0.r: 0 pinned at the crossbar -> 1 at the free edge; COLOR_0.g: 1 = loose secondary parts
meta.uv: bannerSvg viewBox 0 0 100 150, u = x / 100, v = y / 150 (v = 0 at the crossbar), flipY false

meta.description: Chisel-dressed basalt ashlar (3 m): diagonal tooling per block, drafted margins, tight joints, hand-polished patches, weathering rind, salt bloom.
Aged fired brick (2 m): flat 0.42/0.26 x 0.07 m bricks, recessed lime joints, overfired and underfired bricks, chipped arrises, efflorescence and soot in damp zones.

decals.name: mandana_border_ochre
decals.notes: Ochre wash band 0.3 m with white lime line work; v 0.1-0.4 m of the region.

decals.name: mandana_border_white
decals.notes: White lime line work only (braided chain, dots, border lines) for plain mud walls.

decals.name: kolam_pulli
decals.notes: Dot-grid kolam on a swept earth disc (thresholds, courtyards); 1 m.

decals.name: kolam_lotus
decals.notes: Lotus (padma) kolam, no wash disc (stone / plaster floors); 1 m.

decals.name: kolam_star
decals.notes: Eight-point star kolam on a swept earth disc; 1 m.

decals.name: kolam_interlace
decals.notes: Interlaced-circle kolam, no wash disc; 1 m.

decals.name: plaster_crack_corner
decals.notes: Diagonal settlement crack from the top-left corner (place at window / door corners).

decals.name: plaster_crack_craze
decals.notes: Craze / map-crack patch with a few curled plaster flakes; any wall.

decals.name: soot_plume
decals.notes: Soot plume rising from an opening / hearth; the opening top sits at v 0.12 of the region.

decals.name: charring
decals.notes: Burn patch: charcoal with alligator cracking, scorched brown rim, ash; damage stage decals.

decals.name: damp_rising
decals.notes: Rising damp along a wall foot: darker green-grey band to a wavy tide line 0.5-0.8 m with a white salt fringe; the region bottom is the ground line. Tiles in u.

decals.name: damp_leak
decals.notes: Roof-leak / gutter stain running down from the top edge (eave line at v 1.0).

decals.name: puddle_large
decals.notes: Puddle mask: opacity = water (1) + wet rim (0.65); roughness 0.05 in the water.

decals.name: rut_endcap
decals.notes: One cart-rut end: groove 0.22 m wide along +u (toward the road), fading out at u 0.1-0.5; place one per wheel track where terrain_road_earth ruts end (track gauge 1.4 m).

decals.name: footprint_trail
decals.notes: Bare footprints walking +u (v 0.12-0.24) and a cattle hoof trail (v 0.32-0.42); tiles in u.

meta.description: Settlement decal atlas (4 m): plaster cracks, damp stains, soot, charring, mandana borders, rice-paste kolam x4, cart-rut end-cap, puddle masks, footprint / hoof trail. Opacity in ORM.b.
Dust (Eulerian sims): rolling ground puffs (2), closed expanding ring (top view), hoof kick; neutral albedo + normals, tint by ground.
Looping flame (Eulerian sim, licking tongues), gradient-mapped premultiplied emission x6.5 + slight occlusion, no soot; 64 frames at 24 fps.
Four forked lightning bolts, white core + violet glow, additive x10 (high / ultra only).
Mist sprites: bank, wisp, puff, sheet - irregular, wide, noise-eroded clusters; zero at the edges, lit via soft normals.
Nature: sal / peepal leaves and palash petals (8-frame tumbles), kash seed, fireflies + motes (additive).
Rain: streak, 4x4 crown splash, 8-frame ripple (normal map), eave drip.
Billowing smoke puff over life (Eulerian sim, 64 frames, one-shot), lit via density-gradient normals; tint #4a4038 for fires.
Additive sparks (gold -> saffron): spark, embers, slash spark, parry flash, finisher burst with dust shockwave; premultiplied emission x6, lossless.
Weapon trail: dithered gradient-mapped intensity (warm-white edge -> gold -> saffron -> ember-red tail), wide variant, two u-tileable streak noises (raw .r).
Dry-laid granite rubble (3 m): irregular rock-faced blocks, deep joints with chinking stones, speckled grain, water stains, orange and grey lichen.
Cracked dry earth (4 m): drying-mud polygons with curled plates, crusted hairline cracks, dust drifts, half-buried pebbles, straw and leaf bits; macro-neutral.
Pipeline test: hemi-octahedral impostor of the 12 m test tree (A/B with model_test_tree).
Laterite block masonry (2 m): 0.6 x 0.3 m vesicular red-brown blocks with ochre and pale clay-lined pits, manganese spots, chipped arrises, dry joints, dark crust patches.
Lens dirt: soft smudges, fingerprints, a few irregular bokeh shapes, 40 soft specks (low contrast).
meta.usage: bloom dirt mask: bloom *= 0.25 + dirt * strength (ultra only)

meta.description: Weathered hand-troweled lime plaster (3 m): trowel sweeps, craze and settlement cracks, fallen finish coat over brick, rain streaks, damp patches with salt fringes.
32^3 grade LUT (GRADE_PRESETS.dawn); display-referred, after tone mapping.
32^3 grade LUT (GRADE_PRESETS.dusk); display-referred, after tone mapping.
32^3 grade LUT (GRADE_PRESETS.fog); display-referred, after tone mapping.
32^3 grade LUT (GRADE_PRESETS.golden); display-referred, after tone mapping.
32^3 grade LUT (GRADE_PRESETS.haze); display-referred, after tone mapping.
32^3 grade LUT (identity); display-referred, after tone mapping.
32^3 grade LUT (GRADE_PRESETS.monsoon); display-referred, after tone mapping.
32^3 grade LUT (GRADE_PRESETS.night); display-referred, after tone mapping.
Pipeline test: 12 m broadleaf tree (mesh side of the impostor A/B).
Sun-dried mud brick (2 m): 0.4 x 0.1 m bricks in mud mortar, rain-rounded arrises and gullies, slumped and spalled bricks, straw temper, cracks.
Finger-smoothed mud and dung plaster (2.5 m): hand sweeps with finger grooves, straw flecks, shrinkage cracks, spalls; mandana borders are decals.
Flat grooved terracotta roof tiles with hooked lips (2 m): 6 courses x 7 tiles, half bond, channels, drip rims, 3 % broken, lichen rows. u = along the eave, v = up the slope.
meta.vUp: v points UP the roof slope (tile lips face -v)

meta.description: Buff Sanchi/Chunar sandstone trim sheet (same bands as sandstone_carved_red): ashlar, creeper scroll, dentils, padma, bead-and-reel, lotus medallion frieze; black lichen, pink bedding, chipped arrises.
Weathered carved red sandstone trim sheet: ashlar, creeper scroll, dentils, padma, bead-and-reel, lotus medallion frieze; per-block hue jitter, lichen and soot crusts (WP1-09 retune).
Mauryan mirror-polished Chunar sandstone (2 m): cloud mottle, faint bedding wisps, dark speckle, grinding waves; polish dulled in patches. Use with clearcoat 0.6.
Pipeline test: skinned spear-bearer (standard skeleton), idle/walk/attack/die, clipEvents, sockets.
Dawn, sun 6 deg E, pink-gold haze, thin clouds.
Clear late-morning sky, sun 42 deg SE, light haze (lookdev / daytime IBL).
Dusk, sun -2 deg W, afterglow, sky-only lighting.
Shishira fog: low sun, pale fog wall (high / ultra; mobile -> sky_overcast).
Golden hour, sun 7 deg W, warm dusty haze (cinematic / hero mode).
Grishma haze: dusty ochre horizon, almost cloudless.
Moonlit night: stars, Milky Way, thin clouds; moon = manifest sun, irradiance 0.08.
Noon, sun 62 deg S, clear with light cumulus (noon key).
Monsoon overcast: heavy cloud deck, soft diffuse light.
Sanchi-style stupa with carved torana, railings, drum, stairway, harmika and chhatras (trim-sheet sandstone, macro AO/grime).
HDR sun disc (limb darkened) + aureole + halo + faint starburst; L / 50, sRGB.
meta.usage: additive sun sprite: L = texel x hdrScale, tinted by the preset sun color, ~6 deg on screen

meta.description: Gangetic alluvial silt (4 m): dried ripple patches, curled mud-crack flakes, sparse hoof and foot prints, pale crests, damp hollows; macro-neutral.
Ploughed field (4 m): 13 ox-plough furrows along u (0.31 m), clods, tilth, stubble rows, straw; rotate UVs per plot; macro-neutral.
Dry grass splat layer (3 m): straw-khaki bunch-grass tufts, fallen blades, seed stalks, 30 % bare dusty earth with crumbs, pebbles and cracks; macro-neutral.
Monsoon grass splat layer (3 m): olive-emerald blades in five layers, clover, dry straw, dark soil gaps; macro-neutral.
River sand (3 m, flow along +u): asymmetric current ripples with dark heavy-mineral troughs, pale crests, pebbles, shells, twigs, bird tracks; macro-neutral.
Packed-earth road (4 m, u along the road): two bullock-cart ruts 1.4 m apart, hoof-churned centre, footprints on the shoulders, pebbles, straw, dust; macro-neutral.
Sandstone cliff for triplanar projection (10 m, v = up): beds of varying hardness with ledges and undercuts, cross-bedding, joints, honeycomb, varnish streaks, lichen.
meta.vUp: v = world up on side projections

meta.description: Grass/straw thatch (2 m): combed stems in 0.33 m courses, bundles, coir rope bands every 0.67 m, weathered grey top layer. u = along the eave, v = up the slope.
meta.vUp: v points UP the roof slope (stems hang toward -v)

meta.description: Weathered sal timber (2 m, grain along v): five adzed planks, scallops, coarse grain, checks, knots, peg holes, silvering with brown in the grooves.
Carved oiled teak trim sheet (2 m, grain along u): plain beam, bead row, creeper scroll, lotus bracket, bell capital, fluted shaft, studded door panel.
Pipeline test: rigged spear-bearer, idle/walk/attack VAT (15 fps), LOD0 + re-baked LOD1.
